description: Source code for InvadersDashlet class, a custom dashlet for SuiteCRM, including display, scripting, options, and save methods.

classes.name: InvadersDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet class for SuiteCRM, providing display, scripting, configuration, and save functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet, loads language, sets default height and title, and configures properties.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the dashlet HTML content using Smarty templates.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript code for the dashlet from a Smarty template.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays the configuration form for the dashlet.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Filters and saves user-provided configuration options.

methods.name: saveText
methods.description: Saves user input text via AJAX, encodes it in JSON, and outputs the result.
